_comment: NOT YET DEPLOYED. This is a template, not a real deployment record -- every address field below is null because no $CULLER mint has actually been created anywhere. This sandbox has no outbound network access to any Solana RPC endpoint (the same constraint documented for Phase 4 Part A), so scripts/culler/deploy-devnet-mint.ts must be run by a developer with real Devnet access. Once that script succeeds, it overwrites this exact file with the real values and this comment (and the OPEN/UNTESTED status) should be removed.
notes: Run: npx tsx scripts/culler/deploy-devnet-mint.ts <path-to-deployer-keypair.json>, with SOLANA_RPC_URL pointed at a real Devnet endpoint.
